recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reopen only if current generated build artifacts again report Extension.url as changing from uri to string; otherwise this remains a historically applied tooling correction with no current source work.
issue_request: FHIR-18138 reported that the 2018Sep Extension R2/R3 diff tab and global diff page said Extension.url changed from uri to string, while the Structure tab still showed uri. The resolution was to fix the diff comment by fixing the tooling that calculated the diff.
initial_application: Jira's comment points to GH#97e0aea8a4. Commit 97e0aea8a46dc72a076e72d3a6d4c9ce1439e7f7 directly applied the fix by making SpecDifferenceEvaluator describe Extension.url as uri when the converted type descriptor was blank, and by changing extension tab generation from R2 Diff to R3 Diff.
additional_context: The old Java tooling files changed by 97e0aea8a4 are no longer present in the current checkout. Current fhir.ini keeps Extension in active infrastructure/type-page scope, source/datatypes/extension.xml defines Extension.@url as uri, and current templates/diff pages use neutral Version Diff labels and R5/R4B/R4 comparison pages. A related FHIR-17721 no-change audit is already on the combined branch for the broader datatype diff-tab label family and lists FHIR-18138 only as same-change-family evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source hunk is needed because the historical application fixed the reported diff tooling error, the current authoritative Extension source remains uri, and current source/tools contain no stale R2/R3 label or 'Type changed from uri to string' text.
